annotations.title: How can I watch MSNBC on the Internet? – NBC News Group
How to watch MSNBC live online from anywhere in the world | Tom's Guide

content.text:
You can watch **MSNBC live online officially** at MSNBC’s live page, but **unlimited live streaming requires logging in with a participating TV provider**. NBC says MSNBC is streaming online, but you need a supported TV-provider login for the full live stream. ([nbcnews.zendesk.com](https://nbcnews.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45174673222931-How-can-I-watch-MSNBC-on-the-Internet?utm_source=openai))

**Legal/free options:**
- **Use your cable/satellite/live-TV login** at the official MSNBC live page.
- **Free trials** from live-TV streaming services may include MSNBC, such as DirecTV Stream, Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, or Sling—availability and trial terms change. ([tomsguide.com](https://www.tomsguide.com/entertainment/streaming/watch-msnbc-live?utm_source=openai))
- For free news streaming without MSNBC specifically, try **NBC News NOW** or other free live news channels.

Be careful with sites claiming “MSNBC live free HD”—many are unofficial and may be unreliable or unauthorized.
